answer.rationale: I intend to add the low-cost vendor as a qualified second source through a small guarded test. Memory_c2 could support the vendor's onboarding and administrative reliability, while memory_c3 tests whether dual sourcing can reduce single-source delivery risk. With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, switching primary immediately creates material interruption risk; retaining incumbent coverage while qualifying the lower-cost source better protects total cost of ownership and continuity. The test may not capture the full 18% savings immediately, so the cost outcome remains uncertain.
